basic_details.job_title: NLU Delhi Academic Fellow Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: National Law University Delhi (NLU Delhi) has invited applications for 01 Academic Fellow (Criminal Law) on a consolidated pay of INR 60,000 per month, contractual and full time for six months (further extendable). The essential qualification is an LL.M. with specialisation in Criminal Law/allied subjects with minimum 55% marks. Apply online at careers.nludelhi.ac.in by 23:59 Hrs on 20 November 2026. The notice is dated 4 November 2026.

how_to_apply: Candidates should apply only online at https://careers.nludelhi.ac.in up to 20 November 2026 (23:59 Hrs/11.59 PM). The application fee of Rs. 1,000/- is paid online. The materials below must be submitted digitally.
Resume, including publications authored or co-authored, if any
Writing Sample (co-authored pieces shall not be considered)
Copy of undergraduate degree, clearly indicating date and year of graduation
Copy of Master's degree, clearly indicating date and year of graduation
Copy of Ph.D. Degree/Provisional certificate (if any)
Any other document relevant to this application

content_sections.heading: About NLU Delhi
content_sections.text: National Law University Delhi is a law university at Sector-14, Dwarka, New Delhi. The notice describes the Academic Fellowship as a flagship programme of the University to nurture early careers in academics in teaching and research. The Academic Fellow will be mentored by Senior Faculty Members under the Chair on Professional Ethics at NLU Delhi.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Applications are invited from academics and early career scholars in law. The essential qualification is an LL.M. with specialisation in Criminal Law/allied subjects from a recognised Indian or foreign university with minimum 55% marks (or an equivalent grade in a point scale wherever grading system is followed), and a good academic record. The notice also states what is preferred or expected: Excellent skills of writing and drafting will be preferred. Demonstrable research track record in Criminal law/allied subjects. Prior research experience of NLUs will also be preferred. Candidates must fulfil all eligibility conditions as on the last date for receipt of applications. Eligibility is determined on the qualifications and information submitted up to that date only, and no additional documents will be considered afterwards. Candidates currently in employment must submit their application through the proper channel. For the full eligibility conditions, refer to the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The pay is INR 60,000 per month (consolidated). The appointment is contractual and full time for six months, further extendable. It will be purely temporary and will not confer any right to regularization. It will not carry benefits applicable to regular faculty, and it is subject to verification of antecedents. It may be terminated at any time due to misconduct, unsatisfactory performance, or subsequent ineligibility. The rules and regulations of National Law University Delhi apply to the selected candidate.

content_sections.heading: NLU Delhi ACADEMIC FELLOW (CRIMINAL LAW) Job Description
content_sections.text: The Academic Fellow shall be expected to assist research work, in relevant areas in consultation with the University. The Academic Fellow shall also be expected to contribute to other academic/administrative pursuits in the University. The work will require excellent research and writing skills in the area of Criminal Law.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NLU Delhi ACADEMIC FELLOW (CRIMINAL LAW)
content_sections.text: Candidates should apply only online at https://careers.nludelhi.ac.in up to 20 November 2026 (23:59 Hrs/11.59 PM). The application fee of Rs. 1,000/- is paid online. The materials below must be submitted digitally. Cover Letter (300 words) Statement of Purpose (750 words) Specialization of LL.M Resume, including publications authored or co-authored, if any Writing Sample (co-authored pieces shall not be considered) Copy of undergraduate degree, clearly indicating date and year of graduation Copy of Master's degree, clearly indicating date and year of graduation Copy of Ph.D. Degree/Provisional certificate (if any) Experience certificate, if applicable Any other document relevant to this application

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Candidates will be shortlisted based on an evaluation of their application contents. Shortlisting does not guarantee an interview or final selection. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted for an interview, and its details will be communicated separately. Mere possession of the prescribed qualifications does not entitle a candidate to be called for an interview. Shortlisting is based on scrutiny of applications and other criteria decided by the University. Its decision on eligibility, shortlisting and selection is final and binding, and no correspondence will be entertained.

faq.question: Q1. How many Academic Fellow posts are vacant at NLU Delhi?
faq.answer: There is 01 (one) post of Academic Fellow (Criminal Law). The notice says the number can vary if candidates are found suitable for more positions.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for NLU Delhi Academic Fellow?
faq.answer: The last date for online submission is 20 November 2026, up to 23:59 Hrs (11.59 PM).

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for NLU Delhi Academic Fellow (Criminal Law)?
faq.answer: An LL.M. with specialisation in Criminal Law/allied subjects from a recognised Indian or foreign university with minimum 55% marks (or an equivalent grade), and a good academic record.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary of the NLU Delhi Academic Fellow?
faq.answer: The pay is INR 60,000 per month (consolidated).

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: The fee is Rs. 1,000/- (Rupees One Thousand Only), non-refundable, paid online. SC/ST and PwD category candidates are exempted from the fee.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for NLU Delhi Academic Fellow?
faq.answer: Apply only online at https://careers.nludelhi.ac.in by 20 November 2026. Submit the cover letter, statement of purpose, LL.M. specialisation, resume, writing sample and degree copies as listed in the notice.

faq.question: Q7. How are candidates selected?
faq.answer: Candidates are shortlisted on an evaluation of their application contents. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted for an interview, and shortlisting does not guarantee an interview or final selection.

faq.question: Q8. Is the NLU Delhi Academic Fellow job permanent?
faq.answer: No. It is contractual and full time for six months (further extendable). The appointment is purely temporary and does not confer any right to regularization.

faq.question: Q9. Will TA/DA be paid for the interview?
faq.answer: No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview or interaction.

faq.question: Q10. Can employed candidates apply?
faq.answer: Yes. Candidates currently in employment must submit their application through the proper channel.
